form.label: Model Tokenomics
form.description: Per-call model cost and tokens from model.usage records: spend by model, route, connector and profile, token kinds, cache-read and reasoning shares, calls with absent cost, routed against requested model and top users by cost. The dropped-record counter is a metric; see the Grafana Tokenomics dashboard.

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | stats count by connector | sort - count
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats sum(cost_usd) as value | eval value=round(value, 4)

single.option: calls with absent cost add nothing

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats count as value
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats sum(total_tokens) as value

single.option: input + output (cache and reasoning are subsets)

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats sum(cache_read_tokens) as num sum(input_tokens) as den | eval share=round(100*num/den, 2) | fields share

single.option: percent of input tokens read from the provider cache

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats sum(reasoning_tokens) as num sum(output_tokens) as den | eval share=round(100*num/den, 2) | fields share

single.option: percent of output tokens spent reasoning

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats count(eval(cost_basis="none")) as num count as den | eval share=round(100*num/den, 2) | fields share

single.option: percent with cost.basis none (no price entry or no usage)

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(cost_usd) by selected_model limit=10
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(cost_usd) by route_decision limit=10
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(cost_usd) by connector limit=10
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(cost_usd) by profile limit=10

`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(uncached_input_tokens) as input sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read sum(cache_creation_tokens) as cache_creation sum(eval(output_tokens-coalesce(reasoning_tokens, 0))) as output sum(reasoning_tokens) as reasoning

panel.title: Cache-read and reasoning share over time

search.query: `defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | timechart span=1h sum(cache_read_tokens) as cr sum(input_tokens) as ti sum(reasoning_tokens) as rs sum(output_tokens) as tout | eval cache_read_share=round(100*cr/ti, 2), reasoning_share=round(100*rs/tout, 2) | fields _time cache_read_share reasoning_share

`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats count as calls sum(cost_usd) as known_cost_usd sum(total_tokens) as tokens by requested_model selected_model provider route_decision route_source | eval known_cost_usd=round(known_cost_usd, 4) | sort - calls | head 50

`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | stats sum(cost_usd) as known_cost_usd count as calls sum(total_tokens) as tokens by model_user | eval known_cost_usd=round(known_cost_usd, 4) | sort - known_cost_usd | head 20
`defenseclaw_model_usage_events` | search connector="$connector$" selected_model="$model$" | where cost_basis="none" | stats count as calls by selected_model provider | sort - calls | head 20
